text: Dev - new puppy, cockapoo called Biscuit. collecting her Sat 14 Oct. ask how 1st night went

Dalia - moving to Leeds end of Nov for the new job @ the BBC. flat viewing Thurs at 6pm, Headingley, 2 bed w/ a tiny garden. she's nervous re: deposit, landlord wants 6 wks up front + someone else viewing Weds. her dad might lend her some. her cat Tofu would have to come too so needs pet friendly. text her Fri morning to see if she got it
Marcus / cat Pepper at vets tmrw morning - kidney stuff. he's v worried
Mabel's mum 80 on 3rd of June. party @ the cricket club, Mabel doing the cake
bins Tues. dentist 14/05 at 9.10. renew parking permit before the 1st
Grace + Jun - housewarming Sat 21st from 7. new place in Walthamstow. bring something for the garden?
Jun hates mushrooms - note for the housewarming food
Darius - brother Obi starting @ Edinburgh uni Sept, Darius driving him up the wk of the 18th. ask how the drop off went
Kaito: viewing cancelled, landlord pulled the flat. still looking in Bristol, wants 2 bed w/ garden for the dog
Ebony's son Elijah has his grade 3 piano exam Weds at half 2. she says he's terrified. send good luck msg Tues eve
amir - moved in w/ partner Esme last wk. boxes everywhere, no sofa til the 12th lol
Ava's rabbit Clover 5 on Sunday!! she's doing a little party w/ carrots. veg cake?? only Ava
Elif - grandad in hospital since Mon, hip op Fri 10am. she's knackered from driving back + forth. must check in w/ her Fri arvo

Simone - completion moved to 28/11, chain issues again. she's fed up, 3rd delay since Aug. mum moving in w/ her temp till then which is driving her mad. removal firm booked for the 14th had to cancel, lost the deposit. she's been sleeping badly + the cat's picking up on it. must ring her next week, maybe Tues eve after 7
Thabo / works @ Arup, structural eng. into bouldering, goes Tues + Thurs
Vera mentioned her daughter Amara wants a hamster for xmas - Vera not keen. lol
Reza leaving for Lisbon 2nd of Dec - job transfer. leaving drinks Fri 24th @ the Crown, 6ish. don't forget to get a card for everyone to sign
Elijah & Amara getting a rescue greyhound - home check next Weds morning. they're excited
Eli's cat Moose went missing Sun night. posters up. ask Mon if any news

Henrik - mother-in-law visiting from Oslo 9-16 Nov, staying w/ them in the box room. he's dreading it a bit, she rearranges the kitchen every time. his wife Simone thinks it'll be fine. they're taking her to the ballet on the 12th at 7.30, then Bath for the day. kids off school that wk too so chaos. ask him after how it went
Adriana - partner Oliver has his driving test on the 7th at 8.40am. 3rd attempt. she's more stressed than him

Mohammed - wife Sana due in Jan! first baby. he's painting the nursery this wk, sage green, and building the cot Sat morning. her mum flying over from Cairo mid Dec to help for 2 months. they're thinking of moving out to St Albans once the baby's here for the schools. he looked shattered tbh, working late every night to get everything done
call council re: recycling bin. book van for 4th Nov
Oliver back from Kyoto. loved it, wants to move there eventually. speaks a bit of Japanese already
Lwazi & Zhang - vet said their old lab Benji has arthritis, on meds now. they're carrying him up the stairs

Ethan - got into the flat in Clapton!! after like 9 viewings. keys 1st Nov, moving the Sat after, 4th, from 9am. his girlfriend Adriana moving in a month later once her lease ends. he wants a dog eventually, landlord says maybe. need to send congrats + offer to help w/ the move. maybe a housewarming gift - he's been going on abt a decent knife set
Ravi's dad retiring end of month after 35 yrs @ the post office. do @ his local 31st
Dev again - Biscuit's 2nd jabs 3 Nov at 11. puppy classes start after. he's not sleeping much
Dalia got the flat!!! Headingley, 2 bed. moving 25 Nov. remind me to send a plant

Grace - nan passed away last Thurs. funeral 30th Oct at 1pm, St Mary's. Grace v quiet on the phone, not coping great. I should go round w/ food at the wkend, and ask if she wants a lift to the funeral
Darius - hip still bad from rugby, physio Tues mornings
Marcus: Pepper home, ok for now but special diet. he's relieved. follow up next wk re: bloods
Esme (Ezzy) - new job @ the RSPCA centre from Mon 16th. animal care asst. ask how 1st wk went
Kaito found a place!! Montpelier, garden + allows dogs. moving 2 Dec. his bro Ravi helping w/ van
my own move: viewing Fri at 5.30pm, Hackney 1 bed. second viewing Sat 11am if good
Mabel's grandson Ethan - 1st bday 19/11. she wants ideas, says he's obsessed w/ anything that beeps

Obi - finding uni hard, homesick. called Darius twice this wk crying. not eating properly, skipped lectures Mon + Tues. Darius thinks it's the halls, flatmates out every night and Obi doesn't drink. their mum flying up from London on the 28th to see him, staying till Sun. Darius asked me to message him as I did my 1st yr there too, so text Obi this wkend. maybe mention the climbing society
Ebony - Elijah passed! merit. she's buzzing

Amir's sister Elif getting married in Tehran 14 April. they're flying out the 10th, back 22nd. Esme's first time meeting his family - she's nervous, been learning some Farsi on Duolingo + practising w/ his mum on FaceTime every Sun. Amir's brother Reza can't go, visa issues, gutted abt it. their neighbour feeding the cat while they're away
Vera - knee op postponed again, now 6th of Dec at 7.30am. she has to stay in overnight. her husband Reza working nights so ask if she needs a lift
Reza - doesn't drink, keep in mind for the leaving do. into padel
Thabo's girlfriend Dalia - pregnant, 12 wk scan next Mon morning. haven't told family yet
Elif's grandad home from hospital Sun. op went fine. she's back @ work
Simone's cat Dot - 15 tomorrow! oldest cat alive basically. Simone getting her salmon
Sun - Henrik and his wife Simone did their 10th anniv. dinner at Rules, she cried. lovely
Adriana - Oliver failed again by 2 minors. gutted. maybe msg her tmrw, not him
Mohammed - Sana hates the smell of coffee now, morning sickness bad. they've got a midwife appt 2 Nov at 3pm
birthday cards: buy 5. post office before 12 on Sat
Oliver's mum - big 6-0 on 3 March. Oliver mentioned she's been wanting a proper coffee machine for ages

Lwazi - moving to Cape Town w/ Zhang in the spring. Lwazi's parents there, Zhang never lived abroad. selling the house first, valuation 15th at 10am. the dog goes too obv. they seem calm abt it, Zhang less so. find out how the valuation went
Ethan's brother Eli = best man at the wedding Sat 9 Dec. stag in Krakow 17-19 Nov, Ethan going. Eli writing speech, panicking
Ravi - allergic to cats!! keep Ravi away from Simone's
Elijah & Amara - greyhound arrived! called Moss. v timid, hides behind sofa. home check went fine on Weds
Dev's girlfriend Ava - interview @ Google Weds 25th at 2pm. Dev says she's calm, he's not. ask Dev Thurs how it went
Eli - Moose found!! in a neighbour's shed 3 days. thin but ok. vet Fri at 4

Mabel - wedding anniv 40th, 2nd of Dec. her and Henrik were going to renew vows + have a big party @ the golf club. party cancelled now Henrik's back's bad, he can barely sit. small lunch instead, family only, at their daughter Grace's on the Sun after. Mabel a bit sad but says it's for the best. should get them a card + flowers for the 2nd
gym 7am Mon/Weds/Fri from next wk. meal prep Sun

Jun - cousin Amara moving to London from Shanghai in Jan, staying w/ Jun + Grace til she finds a place. Amara's a pharmacist, needs to re-register here. Jun asked if I know anyone at Guy's. I should ask Henrik, his wife works there
Darius Reyes (Daz) - new flat in Peckham, top floor, no lift. moving Sat 4th at 8am. he needs help - I'm doing 8 till 12, then he's got his cousin. text him Fri eve to confirm
Grace - funeral went ok, she said. lots of family over from Jamaica. her aunt staying till mid Nov. pop round next wk w/ cake + see how she's doing. she likes Victoria sponge
